programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: Replacing Dad
programme.desc: Linda and George live in a small town. He is the school principal. They are about to celebrate their 16th anniversary. She catches him with her daughter's young teacher, and has to deal with the kids, the town and her love to him.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: The Forbidden Kingdom (2008) is a kung fu wuxia film directed by Rob Minkoff and starring Jackie Chan and Jet Li. Teenager Jason, who lives in South Boston, is crazy about kung fu. One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: Dinotopia 6: The Exit
programme.desc: After a plane crash, two opposing half-brothers find themselves on an amazing lost island where enlightened pacifist humans and intelligent talking dinosaurs have created a utopian medieval society. But imminent disaster approaches.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: The Society Murders
programme.desc: A building inspector arrives at Wentworth to inspect the rebuilding, but he's a fake. Once inside the jail, he knocks Colleen out, ties her up, and plants bombs around the prison. Meg rescues Colleen, but the women have been locked in the laundry with a bomb inside ticking away... Sharon is charged with murder as Alpha Centauri's true nature is exposed in the press, shattering her illusions. Helen decides to implicate herself to help her sister. Lizzie gets wind of Petra and Scott's relationship but vows to keep quiet. Petra tells Lizzie her father abused her, and was going to do the same to her sister, Emma, which is why she killed him. Later, when Emma visits Petra, we learn it was actually Emma who killed him. Lucy attacks Major the dog to stop him finding her drugs, and a furious Joan turfs her out. Ann forgives Wally. Lizzie gets a telegram from Foxy.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

programme.desc: Daryl Dixon finds himself in France after his departure from The Commonwealth, raising the wrath of a broken but growing tyrannical movement in Paris and endangering a boy at the center of a benevolent religious movement.

programme.title: Prayers For Bobby
programme.desc: Emotional drama based on a true story. In 1970s America, a deeply devout mother finds her religious beliefs shaken when she learns that her son is gay. She urges her son to devote his time to the church in the hope that it will cure him of his 'sin', but the boy's increasing isolation leads to a tragic outcome. The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.title: Icon
programme.desc: On the eve of the elections in Russia, there's an outbreak of a mysterious disease. The British are curious to find out what's going on, so they need to send someone. An official knows someone, Jason Monk, an American Agent who worked deep cover in Russia during the Cold War. He approaches Monk, who initially refuses till he tells Monk that he can help him settle some old scores and to see his daughter whom he left when he was pulled out. So Monk goes and makes contact with an old friend and a Russian policewoman. They learn that someone is trying to manipulate the election.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: Merlin's Apprentice
programme.desc: Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Pirėjo „Olympiakos“ - Stambulo „Fenerbahce“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Ancient Aliens Special Presentation
programme.desc: Humans are just scratching the surface when it comes to what we know about our ancestors from the distant past. Lost cities, ancient texts, mysterious carvings, and unexplained structures provide clues to a long-forgotten time that goes further back in history than we could have ever imagined. From Egypt to China and even Antarctica, Ancient Astronaut theorists propose that the deeper we dig, the closer we will come to proving an extraterrestrial influence on Earth's ancient inhabitants.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner

From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo
programme.desc: From a legendary city swallowed by the jungle, to an underground metropolis stretching 18 levels deep, and even a forgotten pyramid from a lost civilization, sometimes the biggest mysteries on Earth are closer than we think.

programme.title: The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd
programme.desc: History is full of people pushing the limits, but some are more astonishing than others. Like the man who single-handedly liberated a town during World War II. Or a robbery in Buenos Aires that was pulled off with zero casualties.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There: Alien Edition
programme.desc: In this special edition series of The Proof Is Out There, journalist Tony Harris will present compelling evidence of UFO sightings from around the globe. Are these videos proof that aliens exist? Tony and a team of experts will analyze the evidence and render a verdict.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: World War II was the largest, and deadliest, conflict in human history. Can new information help us better understand the strangest tales of the Second World War?

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: During their rise to power and throughout World War II, Adolf Hitler and SS leader Heinrich Himmler led a secret team of elite scholars and archaeologists known as the "Ahnenerbe," whose covert mission was to rewrite history and establish the superiority of the Aryan race, a belief that dominated Nazi ideology. Abandoning science and embracing the occult, the Ahnenerbe conducted dangerous expeditions to the furthest reaches of the planet—all on a hunt for ancient knowledge and artifacts that could deliver Germany a supernatural edge on the battlefield and everlasting world domination for the Third Reich. Revealing the extraordinary true story behind these epic and twisted quests, Secret Nazi Expeditions draws on new evidence, original research, and expert testimony to expose these little-known, yet extraordinary claims and discoveries designed to feed Hitler's propaganda machine.

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: In September 1939, enabled by a secret pact between Adolf Hitler and Josef Stalin, Germany invades Poland with its lightning style of tank warfare, plunging Europe back into war.

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west. The Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilise wartime production.

programme.title: Hitler: A Life in Pictures
programme.desc: From his childhood, Hitler struggled to be noticed until he joined a little-known right-wing political party known as the NSDAP. Together with photographer Heinrich Hoffmann he created an image that would help him achieve power.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: During their rise to power and throughout World War II, Adolf Hitler and SS leader Heinrich Himmler led a secret team of elite scholars and archaeologists known as the "Ahnenerbe," whose covert mission was to rewrite history and establish the superiority of the Aryan race, a belief that dominated Nazi ideology. Abandoning science and embracing the occult, the Ahnenerbe conducted dangerous expeditions to the furthest reaches of the planet—all on a hunt for ancient knowledge and artifacts that could deliver Germany a supernatural edge on the battlefield and everlasting world domination for the Third Reich. Revealing the extraordinary true story behind these epic and twisted quests, Secret Nazi Expeditions draws on new evidence, original research, and expert testimony to expose these little-known, yet extraordinary claims and discoveries designed to feed Hitler's propaganda machine.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: Asia's Killer Hornets
programme.desc: Every Asian giant hornet colony starts with a single queen. Leaving one hive to start another, she'll quickly transform an empty lair into a bustling army of ruthless, efficient killing machines. These hornets will sacrifice everything to help raise legions of grubs and protect the hive at all costs.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: The Emergence. Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move because they are locked into territories.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. An ancient bastion of life anchored in place by 2,000-year-old cypress trees. A labyrinth of flooded forests and pulsing arteries. A place buzzing with new stories: from the mass migration of the world's only social raptor, the swallow-tailed kite, to the dazzling spectacle of the ghost orchid. A world where big mysteries still tread around every corner of the swamp, like the cryptic behavior of the American black bear or the silent footsteps of the Florida panther. Here, in the wet and wild American South, is a place we call the American Amazon, a hotspot of biodiversity rivaling anywhere on Earth, full of stories that have never been told.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's haul.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Ewe Gotta Be Kidding Me. It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Zion's iconic landscapes feature soaring red spires against a clear blue sky. Beyond canyons and cliffs, water emerges as a surprising force. The humble Virgin River, sculpting a geologic masterpiece over millennia, sustains diverse life in Zion National Park. Climbers, bighorn sheep, wild turkeys, and globe mallow bees all find refuge alongside this flowing lifeline.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Docs at Critter Fixer use humor & other de-stressing techniques to cope with the high-stakes challenges of aiding a rat attacked by a dog, removing a ruptured egg from a beautiful bird & saving a canine from a life-threatening condition. Lighter visits include a puppy's 1st exam, a cat losing fur, a guinea pig with an eye scratch, a constipated tortoise & a bearded dragon gender reveal party!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

Discover the parks indigenous heritage, ecological diversity, and geological wonders. Home to the largest collection of geysers on the planet, this American trailblazer shapes how we value and safeguard our most precious lands.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: In the wake of the largest volcanic eruption of the 1900s, an exploration by National Geographic led to the founding of Katmai National Park. programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: As the first national park founded to protect wildlife and ecological richness, the Everglades teems with life above and below water. This land of diversity boasts nine unique ecosystems, each shaped by the wet and dry seasons ebb and flow. Roseate spoonbills, black bears, alligators, bottlenose dolphins and panthers all thrive in the largest subtropical wilderness in North America.

programme.title: The United States of Animals
programme.desc: In the United States, some of the coolest migrations happen closer than you think, many right in your own backyard. From sandhill cranes in Nebraska to monarch butterflies in California, animals pack their bags and travel every year to settle in new homes, and some migrations may be in your hometown. This field guide is guaranteed to mark the spot where you can experience some amazing migrations.

programme.title: Wild Chile
programme.desc: The natural beauty of Chile is explored in this fascinating three-part documentary series from National Geographic, travelling the length, and width, of this unique, slender South American country. Each episode focusses on a particular ecosystem and the animals that have adapted to their environments. From the freezing waters that surround the Antarctic Peninsula and Tierra del Fuego, to the dryness of the Atacama Desert, which receives less precipitation than any other area on Earth, excluding the polar regions, the show highlights the unforgiving landscapes where animals and wildlife have had to adapt in order to survive.

programme.title: The United States of Animals
programme.desc: In the United States, some of the coolest migrations happen closer than you think, many right in your own backyard. From sandhill cranes in Nebraska to monarch butterflies in California, animals pack their bags and travel every year to settle in new homes, and some migrations may be in your hometown. This field guide is guaranteed to mark the spot where you can experience some amazing migrations.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: In the wake of the largest volcanic eruption of the 1900s, an exploration by National Geographic led to the founding of Katmai National Park. From the volcanic ashes, the landscape regenerated, and a vibrant assembly of wildlife emerged. Witness the annual journey of brown bears, wolves, and salmon within the park.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Zion's iconic landscapes feature soaring red spires against a clear blue sky. Beyond canyons and cliffs, water emerges as a surprising force. The humble Virgin River, sculpting a geologic masterpiece over millennia, sustains diverse life in Zion National Park. Climbers, bighorn sheep, wild turkeys, and globe mallow bees all find refuge alongside this flowing lifeline.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: As the first national park founded to protect wildlife and ecological richness, the Everglades teems with life above and below water. This land of diversity boasts nine unique ecosystems, each shaped by the wet and dry seasons ebb and flow. Roseate spoonbills, black bears, alligators, bottlenose dolphins and panthers all thrive in the largest subtropical wilderness in North America.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The New Flock. The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Herd the News. The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. The pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the barn. If all goes well, they'll transport the beams back to the farm.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. But only the most ingenious, industrious and adaptable thrive here, forging clever alliances, exploiting fleeting opportunities, and pushing the limits of endurance in a world where every drop of energy — and every grain of sand — matters.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. But only the most ingenious, industrious and adaptable thrive here, forging clever alliances, exploiting fleeting opportunities, and pushing the limits of endurance in a world where every drop of energy — and every grain of sand — matters.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Winter. Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: The Emergence. Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move because they are locked into territories.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: The Awakening. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, Part 2 is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called 'boss crocs', are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Up Sheep's Creek. The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. The winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, Ben works around the clock.

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When the Gnomes of Tresk are kidnapped by a mysterious evil, Max & the Midknights volunteer to save them. Max is thrilled to go on a new quest, but her plans go awry when she learns that Simon doesn't want to go. Having just settled into Byjovia with his new family, Simon would rather stay home. Despite feeling sad, the Midknights tell him that they understand how he feels. Sadly, Mumblin must also sit out the journey after an accidental tumble down the library steps leaves him in a full body cast. The Midknights set sail down two members. The morning they leave though, Simon has a change of heart. With the help of his animal patients, Simon rushes to the docks to try and catch the Midknights before they sail away from Byjovia. As Simon nears the ship, he and the Midknights are confronted by the angry Clatterback. In the nick of time, Simon convinces the animal to let them go. Simon tells the Midknights that he has changed his mind. They are his family and he's going on this quest with them.

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?

Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.desc: Oscar a Brad Pitt nel film di Quentin Tarantino con Leonardo DiCaprio e Margot Robbie. 1969: le vicende di Sharon Tate si intrecciano con quelle di un attore in declino e del suo stuntman.

Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.desc: Thriller ricco di suspense con Dylan O'Brien, prodotto da M. Night Shyamalan. Quando la piccola Anna scompare misteriosamente nei pressi di un lago, inizia una disperata ricerca.

programme.title: Ai confini del male
programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce e Massimo Popolizio nel thriller Sky Original di Vincenzo Alfieri. Due ragazzi scomparsi dopo un rave, un paese terrorizzato. I carabinieri Meda e Rio sono chiamati a indagare.

programme.title: Everest
programme.desc: Avventura sulla vetta del mondo con Jason Clarke, Josh Brolin, Sam Worthington e Keira Knightley. Due differenti spedizioni sfidano l’Everest ma vengono sorprese da un’immane tempesta.

programme.title: Al vertice della tensione
programme.desc: Thriller con Ben Affleck e Morgan Freeman nel quarto film basato su Jack Ryan, il personaggio creato da Tom Clancy. Il giovane analista della CIA deve fermare un gruppo di terroristi.

programme.title: Il potere dei soldi
programme.desc: Robert Luketic dirige con maestria Gary Oldman e Harrison Ford in uno spy-thriller sullo spietato mondo dell'alta finanza a Wall Street. Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: Vita Privata
programme.desc: Una psichiatra piuttosto nota viene a sapere della morte di una delle sue pazienti. Presto, si convince che si tratti di un omicidio e decide di portare avanti la propria indagine per scoprire la verità.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Il sequel targato Blumhouse che riporta in vita la bambola killer: dopo un necessario upgrade, M3gan e' pronta per fronteggiare Amelia, un'altra bambola creata da una potente azienda con la stessa tecnologia ma piu' crudele e incontrollabile.

programme.title: L'inferno di cristallo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al film precursore del genere catastrofico con Paul Newman e Steve McQueen. L'inaugurazione di un grattacielo a San Francisco rischia di trasformarsi in tragedia.

programme.title: Alex Cross - La memoria del killer
programme.desc: Thriller di Rob Cohen con Tyler Perry, Edward Burns e Jean Reno, dal romanzo di James Patterson. Il detective Alex Cross insegue il serial killer che ha assassinato sua moglie.

programme.title: Heart Eyes
programme.desc: Dai produttori di "Scream", uno slasher horror che tinge di sangue una commedia romantica. Un sadico serial killer che massacra le coppie nel giorno di San Valentino sta per agire di nuovo a Seattle dove prende di mira due colleghi tra cui sta nascendo l'alchimia sentimentale.

programme.title: L'inferno di cristallo

In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.title: Psyco
programme.desc: Lezione di suspense e paura per la regia di Alfred Hitchcock, con Anthony Perkins, Vera Miles e Janet Leigh. Una donna in fuga arriva nel tetro motel gestito dall'inquietante Norman Bates.

programme.title: L'uomo di neve
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jo Nesbo, un thriller con Michael Fassbender, Rebecca Ferguson e Charlotte Gainsbourg, diretto dal regista de "La talpa". Durante l'inverno norvegese, il detective Harry Hole indaga sulla morte di una donna, uccisa nel corso della prima nevicata della stagione. Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

programme.desc: Eric Bana nel thriller tratto dal romanzo di Jane Harper. Non convinto dalla versione ufficiale dei fatti, un poliziotto torna nella sua citta' per indagare sul suicidio di un amico.

programme.desc: John Madden dirige Jessica Chastain nei panni di un'impetuosa eroina della verita'. Una lobbista deve contrastare una proposta di legge sul controllo delle armi. Passera' al fronte opposto.

programme.title: The Watchers - Loro ti guardano
programme.desc: In un bosco nell'Irlanda occidentale, quattro persone si nascondono in un rifugio per proteggersi dalle mostruose creature che appaiono ogni notte. Mentre cercano una via d'uscita, devono fare i conti con l'inspiegabile mistero della foresta.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: M. Night Shyamalan dirige un formidabile James McAvoy. Tre ragazze vengono rapite da un maniaco con 23 diverse personalità, ma la più pericolosa è ancora nascosta nella sua psiche.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della storica saga horror apocalittica. Una ragazza scopre il legame tra un incubo ricorrente e una premonizione avuta da sua nonna che negli anni 60 salvò molte vite. Ma la Morte non dimentica e inizia a perseguitare i discendenti dei sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone dalla parte della legge in un appassionante thriller con Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel e Ray Liotta. Lo sceriffo di una piccola cittadina del New Jersey, abitata soprattutto da poliziotti e per questo soprannominata 'Cop Land', non ha mai fatto carriera. Si limita a svolgere mansioni di poco conto all'ombra dei più agguerriti, e quotati, colleghi in divisa. Ma l'occasione per dimostrare il suo valore arriva, quando è costretto a indagare su una tragedia provocata proprio da uno sbirro e insabbiata dal resto dei poliziotti.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: America Latina
programme.desc: Elio Germano nello spiazzante thriller dei fratelli D'Innocenzo. Latina: un dentista vive in una villa con la sua famiglia. Un giorno, scendendo nelle cantine, incontra l'assurdo.

programme.title: Il codice da Vinci
programme.desc: Tom Hanks in un thriller di Ron Howard tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Per scagionarsi da un'accusa di omicidio, un esperto di simbologia dovra' svelare uno sconcertante segreto.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: Sophie Thatcher e Jack Quaid nel pazzesco fanta-thriller di Drew Hancock. Nella villa di un miliardario, inventore di una rivoluzionaria app per incontri, un gruppo di ragazzi viene travolto da una serie di imprevedibili eventi, fra insospettabili robot e un malloppo da rubare.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: L'uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Elisabeth Moss in un horror targato Blumhouse che rispolvera il personaggio creato da H.G. Wells. Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Il bacio che aspettavo
programme.desc: Deluso da una donna e salvato dalle donne. Succede ad un aspirante scrittore che rompe con la fidanzata storica e si rifugia insieme al suo cuore infranto nel paese della nonna. Nuovi incontri gli faranno tornare la voglia di innamorarsi.

programme.desc: Rebecca Hall e Jason Sudeikis fra i paesaggi dei Maine in una commedia sul senso della perdita. Hannah, la giovane vedova dell'acclamato folk singer Hunter Miles, sta scrivendo la biografia del defunto marito nel tentativo di elaborare il lutto che la tormenta. Alla stesura collabora Andrew, uno scrittore e professore universitario che cerchera' di incrinare il guscio di rabbia e solitudine in cui Hannah si e' rinchiusa. Non solo per ultimare il libro, ma soprattutto per aiutarla a rifarsi una vita. Opera prima di Sean Mewshaw, assistente alla regia di Martin Scorsese in "Gangs of New York".

Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.
